summary: Generated 29 neural curriculum rows for learned adapter/runner/topic launch-routing + abstain: 12 positive (real task cards), 12 collision-aware abstain, 5 synthetic abstain, 1 held-out. Safety gates remain deterministic; no regex/keyword launch authority introduced. No process launch code exists in these artifacts.
neural_bridge_note: These curriculum rows are TRAINING TARGETS for a learned neural router that selects adapter/runner/topic from task context and abstains when evidence is insufficient. The static TOPIC_TO_ADAPTER mapping and infer_adapter() function are curriculum LABEL GENERATORS only — they are NOT runtime launch authority. The collision preflight (B107) provides read-only evidence for abstain decisions. Production routing must be the neural model's learned dispatch, not a regex/keyword cue router. Safety gates (write gate, allowlist) remain deterministic boundaries after the neural router selects.
